'''Razor knucklers''', also amalgamated as '''razorknucklers''', or known simply as '''razors''', were a bladed weapon used for close combat. The polished [[Steel/Legends|steel]] blades and edges gleamed when held in the light. Razor knucklers were favored by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] thugs and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="SWG" />

A variant of this weapon known as a '''malevolent razorknuckler''' also existed inside the [[Sher Kar cave]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Trials">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
